DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Los Angeles Lakers"}, 'dim_opponent'[opponent_name])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"Boston Celtics"}, 'dim_team'[team_name])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_season'[is_complete])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('fact_team_game'[result], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"),
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			__DS0FilterTable3,
			"Matchs__équipe_", '_Mesures'[Matchs (équipe)],
			"Taux_de_victoire_à_domicile", IGNORE('_Mesures'[Taux de victoire à domicile])
		)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(1002, __DS0Core, [IsGrandTotalRowTotal], 0, 'fact_team_game'[result], 0)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC, 'fact_team_game'[result] DESC

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Los Angeles Lakers"}, 'dim_opponent'[opponent_name])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"Boston Celtics"}, 'dim_team'[team_name])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_season'[is_complete])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dim_season'[season_short],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			__DS0FilterTable3,
			"Écart_moyen", '_Mesures'[Écart moyen],
			"v_Écart_moyen_FormatString", IGNORE('_Mesures'[_Écart moyen FormatString])
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, 'dim_season'[season_short], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'dim_season'[season_short]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Los Angeles Lakers"}, 'dim_opponent'[opponent_name])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"Boston Celtics"}, 'dim_team'[team_name])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_season'[is_complete])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dim_date'[date_day],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			__DS0FilterTable3,
			"Forme_de_l_équipe", '_Mesures'[Forme de l'équipe],
			"Forme_de_l_adversaire", '_Mesures'[Forme de l'adversaire]
		)

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyBinnedSample = 
		SAMPLEAXISWITHLOCALMINMAX(
			3500,
			__DS0Core,
			'dim_date'[date_day],
			[Forme_de_l_équipe],
			[Forme_de_l_adversaire],
			350,
			,
			ALPHABETICAL,
			ASC,
			105000,
			60
		)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyBinnedSample

ORDER BY
	'dim_date'[date_day]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Domicile",
			"Extérieur"}, 'fact_team_game'[venue])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"Los Angeles Lakers"}, 'dim_opponent'[opponent_name])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({"Boston Celtics"}, 'dim_team'[team_name])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable4 = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_season'[is_complete])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'fact_team_game'[venue],
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('dim_season'[season_short], "IsGrandTotalColumnTotal"),
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			__DS0FilterTable3,
			__DS0FilterTable4,
			"Taux_de_victoire__carte_de_chaleur_", '_Mesures'[Taux de victoire (carte de chaleur)]
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal] = FALSE)),
			"'fact_team_game'[venue]", 'fact_team_game'[venue],
			"'dim_season'[season_short]", 'dim_season'[season_short],
			"Taux_de_victoire__carte_de_chaleur_", [Taux_de_victoire__carte_de_chaleur_]
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreTableByDM0 = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal] = TRUE)),
			"'fact_team_game'[venue]", 'fact_team_game'[venue],
			"SortBy_DM0_0", [Taux_de_victoire__carte_de_chaleur_]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'fact_team_game'[venue]),
			__DS0CoreTableByDM0
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(101, __DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns, [SortBy_DM0_0], 0, 'fact_team_game'[venue], 1)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals, 'dim_season'[season_short])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(102, __DS0SecondaryBase, 'dim_season'[season_short], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				'dim_season'[season_short],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals,
		"MinTaux_de_victoire__carte_de_chaleur_", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Taux_de_victoire__carte_de_chaleur_]),
		"MaxTaux_de_victoire__carte_de_chaleur_", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Taux_de_victoire__carte_de_chaleur_])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	'dim_season'[season_short]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[SortBy_DM0_0] DESC, 'fact_team_game'[venue], [ColumnIndex]
